Identified as this saint because: Found by route 2: Wikidata Q1052577, 'Cedd, Bishop of London; Saint', carries P373 Category:Ceda of Lastingham and P18 is this same file. 768x1024. It is a stained-glass window of TWO named saints, Alban and Cedd, and the title names both; which of the two figures is Cedd cannot be settled off the picture, only off the title's order. Kept on the precedent of basil-of-mangazeya, whose only file shares its frame with Basil of Caesarea. There is one Saint Cedd, the 7th-c. bishop the Greek calendar keeps on 7 January.
